title: Restore app availability and fix loading failures after redeploy

requirements.text: Rebuild and redeploy the most recent stable version of the app so the published URL loads successfully again.
acceptanceCriteria: The published app loads to the main UI without showing a blank screen or getting stuck on an infinite loading state.
No uncaught exceptions appear in the browser console during initial load.

requirements.text: Make unauthenticated browsing resilient: when backend calls fail due to authorization (e.g., getAllPosts/getAllListings/getPost/getRepliesByPost), the frontend must render a readable logged-out state with a clear call-to-action to log in, instead of failing to render or blocking the entire app.
acceptanceCriteria: When the user is logged out, the Home/Forum/Second-hand pages render a usable read-only UI (or a login-gated UI) without crashing.
If a query returns an authorization error, the UI shows a non-technical message explaining login is required and provides a login button or directs the user to the existing login control.
Admin route (/admin) does not crash for logged-out users; it shows an access/login prompt rather than a blank screen.

requirements.text: Update backend read APIs to support read-only access for unauthenticated callers OR introduce dedicated read-only query endpoints that do not require the #user permission for browsing public content (posts/listings and their details), while keeping write actions (create post/reply/listing, messaging, reporting, favorites) restricted to authenticated community users.
acceptanceCriteria: A logged-out user can load and view the posts feed and listings feed without triggering a backend authorization trap.
A logged-out user can open a post detail and see its replies (filtered for hidden content as appropriate).
Write operations still reject unauthenticated callers.

constraints: Backend must remain single-actor Motoko with all logic in backend/main.mo (do not introduce additional services).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed as frontend immutable hooks/entrypoints.
nonGoals: Do not implement new forum features (mentions, threaded replies, search, notifications) as part of this fix.
Do not change admin moderation behavior beyond preventing the /admin page from crashing when unauthorized.
Do not introduce external databases, third-party auth providers, websockets, or push notifications.
